dir.description: Working directory. Defaults to the directory etch runs in.

skip_if_not_exists.description: Skip this action entirely if the given path does not exist.

id.description: Single app ID. Mutually exclusive with `list`.

list.description: List of apps to install. Mutually exclusive with `name` + `id`.

name.description: Single app name. Mutually exclusive with `list`.

compile_flags.description:
Flags passed to ruby-install after `--`, forwarded verbatim to ./configure.
Example: ["--with-openssl-dir=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3"]

implementation.description: Ruby implementation to install. Defaults to "ruby". Other options: "jruby", "truffleruby".

rubies_dir.description: Directory where rubies are installed. Defaults to ~/.rubies. Passed as --rubies-dir to ruby-install when set.

version_manager.description:
Version manager to notify after installation. When `rbenv`, appends
`rbenv global <version>` and `rbenv rehash` steps after ruby-install.

default_version.description:
Ruby version to set as default in ~/.ruby-version.
Verbatim string written to the file (e.g. "ruby-3.3.0").
If omitted, ~/.ruby-version is not written.

list.description: List of gem names to install. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

name.description: Single gem name to install. Mutually exclusive with `list`.

version.description: Version constraint (e.g. "2.4.0"). Only meaningful when installing a single gem.

list.description: List of package names to install. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

name.description: Single package name to install. Mutually exclusive with `list`.

version.description: Exact version (e.g. "2.28.0"). Only meaningful when installing a single package.

virtualenv.description: Path to a virtualenv. If set, uses `<virtualenv>/bin/pip` instead of `pip`.

list.description: List of module names to install. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

name.description: Single module name to install. Mutually exclusive with `list`.

list.description: List of package names to install globally. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

name.description: Single package name to install globally. Mutually exclusive with `list`.

configure_opts.description:
Value for PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS before invoking pyenv install.
On macOS with Homebrew, use "--with-system-libmpdec=no" to avoid
conflicts between Homebrew-installed libmpdec and CPython's bundled copy.

version.description: Python version to install via pyenv (e.g. "3.12.0").

name.description: Name of the virtualenv to create (e.g. "myproject").

python_version.description: Python version to base the virtualenv on (e.g. "3.12.0").

recreate.description:
When true, delete and recreate the virtualenv if its Python version
differs from `python_version`. Default false preserves existing behavior.

version.description:
Terraform version to install and set as default (e.g. "1.9.0").
If omitted, only tfenv itself is installed.

plugins.description:
Git URLs of oh-my-zsh community plugins to install.
Each URL is cloned into ~/.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/<repo-name>.
The repo name is the last path segment of the URL, with any trailing .git stripped.
